title: ComparisonFinding
description: One row per customer-vs-benchmark comparison result (POLARIS v5.0 section 12.2/12.3, Stage H). Fact and recommendation are kept as separate fields deliberately -- v5.0 explicitly requires separating 'X% of peers do this' from 'consider doing this'.

customer_object_id.description: Null only for MISSING (concept absent from customer pack).

benchmark_concept_id.description: Null only for EXTRA (concept absent from benchmark comparison set).

fact.description: Descriptive, evidence-only statement, e.g. '82% of the selected peer population registers gifts above EUR 25.' Never a recommendation.

recommendation.description: Draft wording only. Never auto-applied. Null when comparison_state is ALIGNED or NOT_COMPARABLE.

evidence_object_ids.description: Which benchmark-side objects support the fact -- must resolve to real objects.

materiality.description: How much this finding matters if acted on -- combines LET criticality and parameter delta magnitude. See recommender/materiality.py.
